blurb: Guests take 40-minute historically narrated boat tours on the James River and Kanawha Canal, seeing Richmond's history and landmarks. Tours operate May through October, seven days a week, departing hourly from the Canal's Turning Basin at 139 Virginia Street. Private charters are available for groups with options for narration or light music and can be booked online with advance notice.
extraNote: Tickets sold first come, first served; online tickets include booking fee · Private charters must be reserved minimum two weeks in advance and can be canceled up to 7 days before without penalty · Private charters subject to weather conditions · 15% gratuity recommended for private charter guides · Canal's Turning Basin at 139 Virginia Street, Downtown Richmond, VA · May through October, varying hours in April and November
